title: Vim Scribe — Ambient AI documentation, built inside Care Insights
markdown:
Ambient AI documentation

# Meet Vim Scribe.  It listens. It documents. It helps you detect diagnosis gaps.

Vim Scribe records the encounter, generates a draft SOAP note, suggests ICD-10 codes, and flags potential Diagnosis Gaps for your review — helping you focus on what matters most: better care. Providers review, confirm, and push to the EHR without leaving their workflow.

How it works

## In-chart, in real time.

Three steps. Zero extra apps. Less time documenting, more time with your patient.

01

Scribe records the encounter

Following patient consent, tap record within your EHR workflow and the transcript builds in real time throughout the encounter.

One tap to start — nothing else to install

02

Review suggestions, push SOAP note

Suggested conditions surface alongside the relevant transcript context. Confirm the right ICD-10 and, following your review, push everything to the open encounter.

Seconds to review — not minutes

03

Close gaps with confidence.

Scribe flags potential Diagnosis Gaps and nudges you to address them. You review and approve every suggestion — so the chart reflects your clinical judgment.

Review and approve, every visit

Within the EHR workflow

What providers see

All in one panel — documentation and gap review, no tab switching.

![Vim Scribe within the EHR workflow — ambient scribe, Care Insights SOAP note, and gap review](https://www.getvim.ai/assets/scribe-mock.png)
